file CMakeLists.txt (3504 bytes)
>| # `import std;` requires CMake >= 3.30 (CMAKE_CXX_MODULE_STD support for GCC)
>| # and a compiler that ships the std-module manifest (GCC 15+).
>| cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.30)
>| 
>| # Opt in to CMake's still-experimental `import std` support. The gate value is a
>| # CMake-version-specific UUID that must match exactly; this one is for CMake 4.4.
>| # Bump it if you move to another CMake.
>| set(CMAKE_EXPERIMENTAL_CXX_IMPORT_STD "f35a9ac6-8463-4d38-8eec-5d6008153e7d")
>| 
>| # Build and provide the `std` module to every C++23 target so sources can
>| # `import std;`. This MUST be set before CXX is enabled by project(): compiler
>| # support for the std module is detected there and skipped if it is off.
>| set(CMAKE_CXX_MODULE_STD ON)
>| 
>| project(demo VERSION 0.1.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)
>| 
>| # >>> cup:compiler-guard >>>
>| # Minimum compiler versions, managed by `cup compiler`. Building with an older
>| # toolchain stops here instead of failing deep in a compile. Change a floor with
>| # `cup compiler set gcc|clang <version>` (docker-verified before it is committed).
>| if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU" AND CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_VERSION VERSION_LESS 15)
>|   message(FATAL_ERROR "cup: this project requires GCC >= 15 (have ${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_VERSION}). Lower the floor with `cup compiler set gcc <version>`.")
>| elseif(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "Clang" AND CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_VERSION VERSION_LESS 17)
>|   message(FATAL_ERROR "cup: this project requires Clang >= 17 (have ${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_VERSION}). Lower the floor with `cup compiler set clang <version>`.")
>| endif()
>| # <<< cup:compiler-guard <<<
>| 
>| set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 23)
>| set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
>| 
>| # Emit compile_commands.json so external tooling (clangd, clang-tidy, sonar) can
>| # see exactly how each translation unit is compiled.
>| set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)
>| 
>| # Collect build results under the build tree so each mode's artifacts are tidy:
>| # with a per-mode build dir (build/<mode>) this puts binaries in build/<mode>/bin
>| # and libraries in build/<mode>/lib.
>| set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin")
>| set(CMAKE_ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/lib")
>| set(CMAKE_LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/lib")
>| 
>| # --- Build configurations: Debug, Release, and Coverage are always available. ---
>| set(CUP_BUILD_TYPES Debug Release Coverage)
>| 
>| get_property(_is_multi_config GLOBAL PROPERTY GENERATOR_IS_MULTI_CONFIG)
>| if(_is_multi_config)
>|   set(CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES "${CUP_BUILD_TYPES}" CACHE STRING
>|       "Available build configurations" FORCE)
>| else()
>|   if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
>|     set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Debug CACHE STRING "Build type" FORCE)
>|   endif()
>|   set_property(CACHE CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE PROPERTY STRINGS ${CUP_BUILD_TYPES})
>| endif()
>| 
>| # Coverage build: instrument with gcov so a report can be generated.
>| if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "GNU|Clang")
>|   foreach(lang C CXX)
>|     set(CMAKE_${lang}_FLAGS_COVERAGE "-O0 -g --coverage" CACHE STRING
>|         "Flags used by the ${lang} compiler for the Coverage build" FORCE)
>|   endforeach()
>|   foreach(kind EXE SHARED MODULE)
>|     set(CMAKE_${kind}_LINKER_FLAGS_COVERAGE "--coverage" CACHE STRING
>|         "Linker flags for the Coverage build" FORCE)
>|   endforeach()
>|   mark_as_advanced(
>|     CMAKE_C_FLAGS_COVERAGE
>|     CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_COVERAGE
>|     CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS_COVERAGE
>|     CMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS_COVERAGE
>|     CMAKE_MODULE_LINKER_FLAGS_COVERAGE
>|   )
>| endif()
>| 
>| include(CTest)
>| enable_testing()
>| 
>| add_subdirectory(src/libs)
>| add_subdirectory(src/apps)
>| add_subdirectory(src/tests)
>|

>| cup_version = "{{CUP_VERSION}}"
>| cpp_standard = 23
>| build_tool = "cmake"
>| 
>| [compiler]
>|   gcc = 15
>|   clang = 17
>| 
>| [docker]
>| 
>|   [[docker.image]]
>|     name = "demo"
>|     base = "gcc:14"
>|     version = 0
>|     default = true

>| # Generated by cup — do not edit by hand.
>| # This is the project's default build image. cup keeps its FROM base and the
>| # apt packages of registered third-party dependencies in sync; `cup docker build`
>| # versions and tags it, and `cup compiler verify` compiles the project in it.
>| #
>| FROM gcc:14
